findings.message: Missing task for the cell-drag owner: `getMeetingRangeOfCells` in packages/client/src/model/meetingRange.ts:69-84 clamps the end to the end of the reference day (`end: highCellEnd.epochMilliseconds < day.end.epochMilliseconds ? highCellEnd : day.end`), and `useMeetingRange.ts:139` builds every cell-drag range through it. The grid-view delta 'Drag across hour cells sets a meeting range' requires that a drag 'MAY run onto the cells of the strip tail' (scenario 'Drag onto the strip tail': column 21 to column 24 → 21:00 on 2026-03-08 to 01:00 on 2026-03-09, FR9). No task in tasks.md (2.1/2.2 implement only D1 = isValidMeetingRange and the handle limits; 4.4 only touches the view hook `useHourCellSelection`) and no design decision (D1, D4, D10) changes `getMeetingRangeOfCells`, so the drag would end at 24:00 and tasks 4.4/5.2 cannot pass as planned. Add a model RED/GREEN task (meetingRange.test.ts) for cell ranges that end in the tail, and name it in D1 or D10.

Contradictory gesture specs for a finger on fitting strips: 'Drag across hour cells sets a meeting range' keeps 'While all cells of the reference day fit without scrolling, a finger drag MUST do the same' (set a range from the cells touched) and excludes only 'A mouse or pen press on an hour cell inside the meeting frame'. Meanwhile 'Move the meeting range by its frame' says 'A finger held for 250 ms on an hour cell inside the frame ... MUST start a move; a finger that moves earlier scrolls the strips or the page as before'. At 1440 × 900, a finger held 250 ms inside the frame and then moved is required both to set a new range and to move the range, and 'scrolls ... as before' is false for fitting strips, where a finger drag set a range before. D6 adds a guard in `useHourCellSelection` for mouse and pen only. Settle which rule wins for a finger on fitting strips (held and not held) in both requirements and in D6, and add a scenario for it.

Task order breaks independent verification: task 4.5 updates `grid_view_meeting_handle_reach_unit.feature` to 'candidate rows below the meeting bar' and requires its steps file to pass. But `MEETING_BAR_SELECTOR` is only added in 6.1, and `useVisibleStripRows`/`getMeetingHandleRow` only learn to count rows below the meeting bar in 6.2, which also updates the same table 'Handle rows among the visible rows' again. tasks.md claims 'each group leaves the app working', yet 4.5 cannot go green before group 6. Move the meeting-bar part of 4.5 into group 6 (after 6.2).

findings.message: tasks.md 2.4 is not independently verifiable: its verification `grep -rn "MEETING_END_BEFORE_START" src` prints nothing cannot hold, because packages/client/src/test/features/meeting_range/meeting_range_wall_times.feature:34-35 still holds `| Almaty | 2026-03-08 | 12:00 | 10:00 | MEETING_END_BEFORE_START |` and the 22:00/02:00 row, and that feature is only updated in task 2.5. Also, removing the error-to-outcome map entry in 2.4 leaves src/controller/useMeetingRange.input.test.tsx:69-70 (expects MeetingRangeInputOutcome.END_BEFORE_START for '12'/'10' and '22'/'2') failing until 4.1, against the plan's own 'each group leaves the app working'. Reorder: fold the feature update into 2.4, or move the grep to 2.5, and move the controller map removal to 4.1.

tasks.md 5.2 says to add 'Slider values off the track step' to grid_view_meeting_handles_e2e.feature, but that scenario already exists in packages/client/src/test/features/grid_view/grid_view_meeting_handle_reach_e2e.feature:62 (`@refine-meeting-range-entry-and-handles @FR4 @NFR-A2`). The task must update the existing scenario (end maximum 1985) instead of writing a second copy.

tasks.md 6.5 puts 'Handles stay on screen in a long list' into the new grid_view_meeting_move_e2e.feature, but it already exists as a Scenario Outline at grid_view_meeting_handle_reach_e2e.feature:11 (`@refine-meeting-range-entry-and-handles @FR7 @NFR-R1`). The modified requirement 'Meeting handles on the frame' should be covered by updating that scenario (below the meeting bar, add `@move-meeting-range-and-extend-past-midnight @FR13`). The task's verification `--grep "meeting bar stays|not hidden under"` also runs neither that scenario nor 'The normal header still scrolls away'.

Glossary term 'Midnight marker' (docs/glossary/time-selection.md:36: 'the reference zone's row shows a plain `0`') changes meaning under FR7 / the modified 'Midnight marker in the hour strip' (the first tail cell of the reference zone's row is its midnight cell). Neither the proposal's 'Changed terms' list nor task 1.3 updates it. .claude/rules/glossary.md: 'A change that shifts a term's meaning, owner or Russian name updates the entry in the same change.'

design.md Context lists '**Grab area** gesture constants: `REORDER_POINTER_ACTIVATION_DISTANCE_PX`, `REORDER_TOUCH_ACTIVATION_DELAY_MS`, `REORDER_TOUCH_ACTIVATION_TOLERANCE_PX`' among owners 'in docs/glossary/time-selection.md'. 'Grab area' is in docs/glossary/locations.md:21, and its Code reads 'the place and zone line elements of `ZoneRowContent`'; it names no constants. Fix the claim, or add the constants to that entry's Code in task 1.3, since D6 reuses them as the owner of the hold gesture.
